data.name: Magical Aptitude (Mythic)
data.description: Your understanding of the principles and intricacies of magic goes far beyond your training. The bonus on Spellcraft and Use Magic Device skill checks from Magical Aptitude increases by 2. In addition, you can expend one use of mythic power to treat a Spellcraft or Use Magic Device check as if you had rolled a natural 20. You must decide to use this ability before making the roll.
